def slugify(title):
    """Convert a title to a URL-safe slug."""
    s = title.lower()
    s = s.replace('&', ' and ')
    s = ''.join(ch for ch in s if ch.isascii() and (ch.isalnum() or ch in ' -'))

    s = s.strip('-')
